Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Efficient use of energy, environmentally-friendly mobility and security in a connected world we solve some of the most critical challenges that our society faces while taking a conscientious approach to the use of natural resources. 2 Internship - Electro-Acoustics and Signal Processing (f/m/div) Job IdHRC1455142JobfamilieResearch & DevelopmentBeschäftigungsartVollzeit / TeilzeitVertragsdauerBefristetArbeitsplatztypHybridEinsteigen alsStudent*in/Praktikant*in/Trainee#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. The future won't wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Expert Collaboration: Work with experts at a global semiconductor company and leading MEMS microphone supplier to develop and characterize next-generation audio technologies

 * Electro-Acoustic Support: Support the team with a strong focus on electro-acoustic lab work and early-stage concept development

 * Product Insights: Gain insights into the development of MEMS audio products for smartphones, hearables, IoT and automotive applications

 * Performance Analysis: Measure and analyze performance parameters as well as audio quality of existing and next-generation microphones

 * Novel Concepts: Work on novel sensing concepts, experiment design, fixture preparation, data processing and visualization (e.g., Python, MATLAB) and listening tests

 * Innovation Contribution: Help shape the next generation of microphone solutions

Further Information

Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)

Duration: min. 12 months

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

 * Education: Motivated and committed master student (f/m/div) from the field of Electronics or Electrical Engineering with focus on Audio Engineering or similar

 * Knowledge: Background in acoustics and signal processing

 * Lab Skills: Hands-on experience in laboratory environments

 * Curiosity: Curiosity for state-of-the-art developments of microphone solutions in the semiconductor industry

 * Language Skills: Good English skills

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2025.pdf).

Please attach the following documents (German or English) to your application:

 * Motivation letter

 * CV

 * Certificate of matriculation at a university

 * Latest Transcript of records (not older than 6 months)

 * Highest completed educational certificate (Matura certificate for Bachelor students, Bachelor certificate for Master students)

 * Reference letter (optional)

jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

Wir machen das Leben einfacher, sicherer und umweltfreundlicher, mit Technik, die mehr leistet, weniger verbraucht und für alle verfügbar ist. Mikroelektronik von Infineon ist der Schlüssel für eine lebenswerte Zukunft. Wir achten auf schonenden Umgang mit natürlichen Ressourcen und lösen gesellschaftliche Herausforderungen: Effiziente Energienutzung, umweltgerechte Mobilität und Sicherheit in einer vernetzten Welt. 2 Staff Engineer Application Stress Test Methodologies (f/m/div) ID: HRC1166867

Join us at KAI and become a key player in the semiconductor industry, where every design and test brings us closer to a sustainable, electrified future! As our new Staff Engineer specializing in Application Stress Test Methodologies, you¿ll dive into the world of next-generation wide-bandgap power semiconductors, designing innovative test systems that explore performance under extreme conditions.

At KAI, we strive to create pioneering reliability test methods and systems for robust power semiconductor technologies. Your know-how in designing and developing test systems will help us push our technology to its limits while collaborating with a team of innovators.

Your new responsibilities:

Develop and design advanced power electronic circuits through simulations and concept studies

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather and manage system requirements effectively

Transform designs into hardware, overseeing the complete implementation process, and supervising the manufacturing phase

Evaluate and validate designs within an industrial laboratory setting

Lead stress testing using both established and newly developed test systems

Document designs, concepts, and results with clarity and precision

You are a hands-on innovator with a passion for high-performing power electronic systems. You thrive on bringing ideas to life, blending technical understanding with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Your toolkit for success includes:

Master's / PhD in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

Strong expertise in SPICE and system-level simulations of power electronic circuits

Proven experience in PCB design using industry-standard tools like ALTIUM Designer

Practical experience with power electronic hardware design, from concept to laboratory validation

Excellent communication skills in English and/or German

The ability to lead and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative workspace

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry, at least employment group G (https://www.feei.at/leistungen/informations-service/mindestlohne-und-gehalter). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. A higher payment is negotiable depending on your expertise and skills. Furthermore, Infineon offers additional employee benefits.

Aqipa distributes and markets Consumer Electronics products and continues to grow to this day. We are on the lookout for motivated employees who are keen to contribute to our international success story together.

• Creation of shelf concepts using a special planogram software

• A degree in economics or engineering (University, college or equivalent)
• Very good command of Swedish and English and hopefully one or more of the following: Norwegian, Danish or Finnish – any level of German beneficial
• Comfortable with Microsoft Office programs
• Knowledge of Adobe Photoshop of definite advantage
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently

jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

As a Senior Expert Corporate Production Management (m/f/d) at Exyte, you will play a key role in implementing and further developing our Lean philosophy across international projects.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Implementing Lean Design and Lean Construction methods across all project phases using PPM (Project Production Management), LPS (Last Planner System), and Exyte standard software.
- Training project team members and key users on Lean Construction methods, tools, and software.
- Continuously improving and optimizing standardized Lean tools and methods in close collaboration with stakeholders.
- Driving the transformation and development of high-performance teams by inspiring enthusiasm for Lean principles and production control.
- Acting as the first point of contact for all Lean Design and Construction-related topics within projects.

Show your expertise

- A degree in engineering or project management.
- Extensive expertise in Lean principles.
- 10+ years experience in construction projects and the implementation of Lean project delivery methodologies.
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to facilitate workshops and trainings.
- A hands-on mentality and the motivation to drive sustainable improvements.
- Readiness to undertake regular weekly travel to our project sites for up to five days per week to support and train teams in the implementation of Lean principles and production control.
- Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken).

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues.
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks.
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team.
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working.
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor.
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany.

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

Strong understanding of IT services, industry best practices, and current trends.
Excellent business acumen with strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills.

In this key position as a Senior Expert Risk Management (m/f/d), you will work closely with our project teams to provide key information and decision-making. As a business risk and opportunity expert, you will be an indispensable advisor and driver, directly influencing our business. This varied role requires a comprehensive understanding of the EPC project business and the ability to interact with stakeholders at all levels. The position is based in Stuttgart, Germany and you will be part of an international team of experts that prepares decision papers, makes recommendations and prepares project-specific risk analyses and evaluations for global bids and projects as part of project-related risk and opportunity management.If you would like to actively shape the future of our company, we look forward to receiving your application.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Coordinate opportunity-risk analyses according to internal guidelines in cooperation with business partners from different regions, focusing on independent risk analyses along all relevant risk categories.
- Ensure thorough review and agreement of analysis results, recommendations and approval conditions, supported by appropriate documentation, in consultation with line manager.
- Individually review project performance and risk indicators.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Project Manager / Project Controller (f/m/d) for Germany (Vertriebscontroller/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Project Controller / Commercial Project Manager (f/m/d), you will be the financial lead for a portfolio of complex real estate construction projects within Siemens Energy. Acting as the trusted finance business partner to the Real Estate Project Management organization, you will oversee budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and investment approvals while ensuring full compliance with IFRS and local accounting standards. Working closely with colleagues from Accounting, Operations, Procurement, Legal, and Real Estate, you will provide transparent financial insights that support strategic decisions and drive successful project delivery.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the commercial execution of a dedicated portfolio of real estate construction projects, including budgeting, forecasting, cost recognition, and financial reporting
* Prepare robust investment approvals by developing business cases, profitability analyses, and discounted cash flow models for strategic construction initiatives
* Establish accurate financial project structures in SAP, including Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure alignment with approved project budgets and schedules
* Ensure timely month-end closing, accurate project accounting, and full compliance with IFRS and Local GAAP throughout the project lifecycle
* Present clear financial performance reports, highlight cost deviations, and provide actionable recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders
* Partner with cross-functional teams across Finance, Real Estate, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to enable informed commercial decision-making and successful project execution

What You Bring

* A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Economics; a master's degree or CPA qualification is an advantage
* Longstanding professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Project Finance, ideally within construction, infrastructure, or capital investment projects
* Strong understanding of Financial Planning & Analysis/Business Case Models in preparation of investment approvals (e.g. proof of profitability & discounted cash flow calculation
* Proven experience managing CAPEX projects, annual budgets, forecasting, free cash flow, depreciation, and financial reporting for complex project portfolios
* Solid knowledge of IFRS and Local GAAP, with hands-on experience in PP&E (CAPEX) accounting and strong SAP expertise, ideally across PS, CO, and FI modules
* Business fluent English communication skills

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
